headline: Base Lines Shift on Active Fronts
war_summary: The latest returns show the Nevish Line and Weathered Expanse still leading the base struggle, with 57 and 52 events respectively in the past day. Nevish is markedly busier than the prior report: 12 events came in the latest two hours, though its balance remains six Warden bases to two Colonial. Weathered recorded seven recent events and now stands at two Warden, three Colonial and four neutral bases, against one, five and three in the previous edition. Kuura Strand’s daily count rose to 38, but its six bases are now all Colonial-held and it logged no event in the latest two hours. Marban Hollow has 32 events, down from 39, with no recent activity; Linn Mercy’s 11-event count is unchanged and likewise quiet in the latest interval. Godcrofts reported six events, last recorded early today. Casualty counters have surged in Nevish, Weathered and Deadlands, though Deadlands reported no base events. War 140 remains undecided; 34 victory towns are required.
